release_notes:
## What's New & Fixed

- Rebuilt the Save Layout window with separate Save New and Update Existing sections.
- Existing layouts for the current Normal, Platformer, Creator, or Platformer Creator mode can now be selected and updated directly.
- Added confirmation before replacing an existing layout.
- Updating captures the current transforms, information cards, and complete Trash state.
- The Android keyboard no longer opens automatically when the Save window appears.
